info.name: Hotel Management API — Phase 1
info.description: Phase 1 (Foundation / RBAC) endpoints for the Hotel Group Management Platform API, generated directly from the current Laravel routes, Form Requests, and API Resources under /api/v1. Only endpoints that exist in the codebase today are included. Collection-level auth is Bearer {{access_token}}, populated automatically by the Login request.

Validated by StoreHotelRequest: hotel_group_id (required, integer, exists:hotel_groups,id), name (required, string, max:255), slug (required, string, max:255, alpha_dash, unique:hotels,slug), country (nullable, string), city (nullable, string), timezone (optional, string, max:64), is_active (optional, boolean). Requires hotels.manage (Group Owner only). Saves the created id to {{hotel_id}}. Run "Create Hotel Group" first so {{hotel_group_id}} is set.

App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\HotelController::show. Requires hotels.view AND that the authenticated user's own stored hotel access includes this hotel (or Group Owner). Returns 403 for an unassigned hotel, 404 if it does not exist.

item.description: HotelController: hotel-scope isolation enforced server-side via the authenticated user's own stored hotel access — a client-supplied hotel_id can select which hotel to view, never widen what is authorized.

request.description: App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\UserController::store. Validated by StoreUserRequest: name (required), email (required, unique:users,email), password (required, min:8), role_id (required, exists:roles,id), is_active (optional, boolean), hotel_ids (optional array of ids existing in hotels). Requires users.manage (Group Owner only). Saves the created id to {{user_id}}. Run "Create Hotel" first so {{hotel_id}} is set; {{role_id}} is auto-resolved by the pre-request script if not already set.
App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\UserController::show. Any authenticated user may view their own profile this way; viewing another user's profile additionally requires users.view or users.manage.

App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\UserController::update. Validated by UpdateUserRequest (all fields "sometimes"; password nullable — omit or leave blank to keep the current password; hotel_ids, when supplied, replaces the user's hotel access). Requires users.manage (Group Owner only).
App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\UserController::destroy. Requires users.manage (Group Owner only) and the target must not be the caller themselves (self-deletion is rejected).

item.description: UserController: staff account management, RBAC role assignment, and user_hotel_access — Group-Owner-only for create/update/delete; any user may view their own profile.

item.name: 04 Status Transitions

request.description: `booked` is rejected by Rule::in() validation before RoomService ever runs.
Matches Phase 2B behavior: a same-state request is not in RoomService::ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS, so it is rejected rather than treated as a no-op.

PREREQUISITE: {{room_id}} must already be in `booked` status. Phase 2's API has no way to reach `booked` (by design), so set it directly for this check only: `UPDATE rooms SET status='booked' WHERE id = {{room_id}}`. Not a normal applicati­on flow — verification-only.
Same prerequisite as the previous request — {{room_id}} must be manually set to `booked` in the database first.

item.description: available <-> under_maintenance, and every rejected transition involving booked.
